intro: Apothecary Helbrim is an emissary of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed in the dusty heart of the Crossroads. Sent all the way to Kalimdor to harvest unfamiliar reagents, he studies the native flora and strange ecology of the Barrens on behalf of the Forsaken.

p: While most of the Royal Apothecary Society remains sequestered in the damp underbelly of the Undercity, Helbrim operates out of the harsh sun and parched red dirt of the Crossroads. Sent far across the Great Sea to Kalimdor, his mission is simple yet crucial: identify and extract useful flora, fungi, and natural specimens from the Barrens. To this end, he relies on passing adventurers to gather samples, such as local fungal spores, and coordinates directly with his colleague, Apothecary Zamah, over in Thunder Bluff. His presence reminds travellers that the reach of Sylvanas's alchemists extends well beyond the ruined borders of Lordaeron.
